finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_exact_close_level_diversity_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.concept: Order-invariant Simpson diversity of exact minute close-price identities over the fixed 240-bar continuous grid.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It measures the breadth of distinct transacted close levels across all unordered within-day bar pairs, not adjacent update frequency, coarse price-range occupancy, return order, range mass, volume, or a terminal-factor combination.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Prior source-semantic evidence says 09:30 price fields may be a zero-activity reference placeholder; a price-range interpretation is not accepted even though 09:30 amount has a separate terminal contract.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_sign_transition_entropy_238p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.concept: Entropy of adjacent ternary return-sign transitions within the two half sessions.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Return-sign continuity, run imbalance, weak-order entropy and reversal topology are already terminal; changing the categorical summary would be a family rescue.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_exact_close_level_diversity_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A broader set of exact intraday close-price levels reflects sustained price discovery and usable liquidity rather than repeated anchoring at a small set of ticks, which may persist over the next-open to third-close horizon.
selected_candidate.formula: On exactly 240 selected bars, group exact close values with counts n_j and return 1 - sum_j n_j*(n_j-1)/(240*239), equivalently one minus the fraction of ordered distinct-clock pairs sharing the same exact close.
